name: Dev Delivery and Templates pages are accessible by direct URL after login
description:
Objective: Dev Delivery and Templates pages are accessible by direct URL after login.
Preconditions: Open Notification portal dev env with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Notification portal dev env.
2. Dev Delivery and Templates pages are accessible by direct URL after login.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: After configured app login, directly navigating to /delivery and /templates by URL should both work without a login redirect.
